_references: Massie et al. (2012) Quantification of High Specificity Cyclic di-GMP Signaling. PNAS 109:12746-51
Gillespie (1977) Exact stochastic simulation of coupled chemical reactions. J Phys Chem 81:2340-2361

_provenance.generated_by: Gillespie SSA simulation of c-di-GMP birth-death process
_provenance.data_origin: Enzyme counts from V. cholerae genome (Massie 2012 PNAS SI). Kinetic parameters from standard c-di-GMP literature.

_description: Stochastic simulation of enzymatic signal specificity in c-di-GMP signaling
_groundspring_question: How does a cell resolve signal from noise when 40+ enzymes compete for a single diffusible molecule?

enzyme_network._description: Simplified V. cholerae c-di-GMP enzyme network

analytical_predictions._description: Birth-death steady state: S* = total_syn / total_deg

expected_results.steady_state_mean_tol_rationale: Birth-death S*=40/2.2≈18.18; Gillespie SSA with 200 replicates gives SE ≈ sqrt(18.18)/sqrt(200) ≈ 0.30; 1.0 provides 3.3x margin.
expected_results.steady_state_std_tol_rationale: Poisson std = sqrt(18.18) ≈ 4.26; sample std estimation error at 200 reps is ~4.26/sqrt(400) ≈ 0.21; 1.5 provides 7x margin for SSA discretization effects.
expected_results.snr_alpha_10_range_rationale: SNR = (mean_activated - mean_basal) / std_basal ≈ (22.27 - 18.18) / 4.26 ≈ 0.96; [0.5, 2.0] covers variance in both numerator and denominator estimates.
expected_results.snr_alpha_20_range_rationale: SNR ≈ (26.82 - 18.18) / 4.26 ≈ 2.03; [1.0, 4.0] provides 2x margin for stochastic estimation with 200 SSA replicates.
expected_results.response_ratio_alpha_10_range_rationale: Analytical ratio = 49/40 = 1.225; [1.1, 1.4] covers ±10% from Gillespie sampling noise at 200 replicates.
expected_results.response_ratio_alpha_20_range_rationale: Analytical ratio = 59/40 = 1.475; [1.3, 1.7] covers ±12% from SSA stochastic noise.
